title: At least l pairs of normalized weak solutions for a fractional (p,q)-Laplacian equation in the whole space
author: Lihong Bao, Libo Wang, Min Li
work: Multiple normalized solutions for fractional (p,q)-Laplacian equations in R^N
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations, Vol. 2026 (2026), No. 14, pp. 1--20; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.14; published February 13, 2026; publisher version
difficulty_reason: After the fractional Sobolev embeddings for the intersection space, the autonomous compactness Lemmas 2.3--2.5 and the non-autonomous compactness Lemma 3.4 are supplied as context, the counted theorem still demands l distinct normalized critical points at negative levels. The author has to run Ekeland variational principle on the L^p mass constraint at each level eta_eps^i, keep the minimizing sequence away from the boundary of the sets theta_eps^i by Lemma 4.2, differentiate along the two-term normalisation path sigma(t) that preserves the mass constraint in order to convert the Ekeland inequality into the constrained Palais-Smale condition, feed the result into the compactness Lemma 3.4 under the strict level bound eta_eps^i < M_max(a)+rho, separate the l limits through the disjoint balls around the maximum points of h, and finally force the Lagrange multipliers to be negative by a Pohozaev-type identity. This normalized-solution multiplicity mechanism under a double (p,q) nonlocality is research level rather than a qualification exercise.
